_comment: Overlay on data/resume.json for survey research science and consumer insights roles — the market-research end of data science, where survey methodology and statistical modeling are wanted together. Build with `python3 tools/build_resume.py --variant survey`.
title: Research Scientist
tagline: Survey research, statistical modeling, and insurance analytics.
summary: Research scientist with a Ph.D. in Cognitive Psychology, nearly four years of insurance analytics, and nine years designing and analyzing survey and experimental studies. Works daily in Python and SQL over large, complex datasets — cleaning, modeling, validating, and automating the reporting around them — on a foundation of measurement design and statistical inference from ANOVA through structural equation modeling.

bullets: Extract and join data from large, complex sources in Microsoft SQL Server, then clean, transform, and model it in Python.
Run, adjust, and validate established machine-learning models (XGBoost), interpreting predictions for underwriting and claims questions.
Built an automated reporting pipeline that calls an LLM to generate written insights alongside the quantitative results.
Design custom analyses out of exploratory investigation and build the reports and dashboards that deliver them to internal teams and external stakeholders.
Led statistical analysis for large-scale behavioral clinical trials, working across longitudinal survey and assessment datasets and multiple analysis platforms.
Designed and fielded survey instruments in Qualtrics, and established statistical performance norms for the measures collected.
Built regression models identifying the variables that drive participant outcomes, and integrated qualitative interview data with quantitative measures.
Published results in peer-reviewed journals and presented findings at national conferences.
